slides.say: Some widgets are not written in React, like a map with a set zoom level method. Keep it in sync with an Effect.
No cleanup needed here. Calling set zoom level twice with the same value does nothing, so the dev double run is harmless.
But some APIs throw if called twice, like show modal on a dialog. Then close it in the cleanup.

slides.text: Ask: is calling setup twice harmless? If not, undo it in cleanup.
slides.say: Ask yourself: is running setup twice harmless? If not, undo it in the cleanup.
